data.answer: Odoo announced plans to open a new office in France by Q2 2026, with internal sources indicating Lyon as the location. General Atlantic announced a follow-on investment in Odoo in January 2026, valuing the company at €7 billion and acquiring an additional stake from Wallonie Entreprendre. Odoo's latest release, Odoo 19, has introduced AI features and expanded its suite of business applications, making it a preferred choice for SMEs.

# Odoo news December 2025

19 December 2025

Here are all the essential ERP and Odoo news of December you should not miss.

### Overview

Leaks from Odoo HQ 🕵️

Latest community buzz 💬 [...] A recent community discussion has shed light on just how dominant Odoo has become in its home market.   
  
After a LinkedIn post from an Odoo employee raised a few eyebrows, claiming that 1 in 5 Belgian companies now run on Odoo, CEO Fabien Pinckaers stepped in to verify the numbers with a more transparent breakdown.

His data reveals that Odoo is currently used by roughly 37,000 active companies in Belgium (out of the ~200k total Belgian companies with at least one employee).

[...] The Company’s latest release, Odoo 19, has further accelerated global adoption across diverse industries by introducing natively integrated AI features and expanding its suite of business applications. results.title: Odoo tops €7 billion valuation as General Atlantic increases stake
results.content:
Belgian business software company Odoo, also a unicorn, has reached a fresh milestone. Growth investor General Atlantic has increased its stake in the firm, buying additional shares from regional backer Wallonie Entreprendre and pushing Odoo’s valuation to roughly €7 billion. [...] Part of what makes this update noteworthy is how Odoo has expanded its product offerings. Its newest versions include AI-infused features and automation tools that make the suite more attractive to businesses looking to replace outdated, fragmented systems with a single, unified digital platform. [...] Today, Odoo counts more than 170,000 paying customers in around 180 countries. That global footprint and the steady revenue growth it has delivered helped convince General Atlantic to deepen its involvement.

Since first investing in the company in 2023, the firm has supported Odoo’s expansion into new markets and helped refine its commercial strategy.
